title: Smarter Weather examples index
description: One entry per example, surface and language. An example in several languages, or on several surfaces (REST and an SDK), is several entries sharing one id; (id, surface, language) is unique, which the validator checks. To add a surface or a language, add it to the enum below.

id.description: URL slug (developers.smarterweather.com/examples/<id>/), shared by every surface and language of the same example.

surface.description: rest: plain HTTP calls. mcp: an MCP client wired to the weather server. sdk: reserved for when an SDK ships. The directory under examples/ is named after the surface.

kind.description: code: a program that calls the API and opens with the placeholder key constant. config: a client config that holds no key at all.

dir.description: Directory under examples/, starting with the surface.

portal_guide.description: Playground guide slug on developers.smarterweather.com, when one matches.

test.description: Shell command CI runs in dir (see _harness/). Entries without one are listed but not run.
